background: Citibank, N.A. is the main operating bank of Citigroup, with the broadest international network of any US bank, serving multinationals, institutions and consumers across around a hundred countries.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, the bank's credit standing is firm and leaning upward. The balance sheet is strong against US banks: CET1 of 13.8% is above the peer median, leverage of 7.9% is in the top quarter and LCR of 128% is in the top quarter. LCR has risen 11 points since 30 Jun 2024, with CET1 broadly flat. The weak spot is conduct rather than credit, with a run of flagged items on sanctions-control failures, the newest a UK fine on 11 Sep 2026.
